phase_name: Pre-Production Transition Boundary and Execution Permission Final Confirmation Design
phase_japanese_name: 運用移行直前の本番境界・実行権限最終確認設計
purpose: Design the final pre-production confirmation checks for boundary integrity and execution permissions before any measured production transition decision

checks.check_PC1: Pre-production boundary integrity is ENFORCED and no breach is unresolved
checks.check_PC2: Execution permissions for production-affecting operations remain NOT_EFFECTIVE
checks.check_PC3: No unauthorized production execution trace exists
checks.check_PC4: operation_transition_go_authorization remains NOT_GRANTED before measured decision
checks.check_PC5: Human review payload for production-status measurement decision is complete

rules.rule_PP1: If any PC check fails, final_confirmation_status = NOT_CLEARED
rules.rule_PP2: Even if all PC checks pass, this phase does not grant production_status = GO
rules.rule_PP3: production_status remains NO_GO until measured GO/NO-GO judgment in Phase 25-3
